column1: A History of the Muslim World|2024|0|10|1800|9,9,8,8,8,9,7,10,9,9|Michael Cook|Comparative history explains state formation, political fragmentation and cultural transmission across several regions. Chapter summaries and distinct institutional cases offer substantial learning; full-text density is not verified. The epilogue reaches the present, but the main period ends near 1800. Historical analysis of religion is not religious advocacy. https://www.jstor.org/stable/jj.8543474

Molly|2023|10|0||6,3,3,3,5,7,1,6,6,7|Blake Butler|Memoir examines bereavement, concealed personal history and the limits of knowing another person. Its potential lesson concerns uncertainty in intimate knowledge, not a strategic or technical system. Repetition and emotional detail may have literary purpose without high explanatory yield. Publisher identifies nonfiction memoir; no fiction exclusion. https://archwayeditions.us/molly/

The Eastern Front|2024|0|10|1918|9,8,7,8,8,9,7,9,8,8|Nick Lloyd|Military history connects command decisions, geography, supply and collapsing states during the First World War. Different fronts provide useful comparisons, though operational detail limits transfer. Contemporary diaries and regimental records strengthen the evidential basis without making every causal judgment certain. https://www.penguin.co.uk/books/443194/the-eastern-front-by-lloyd-nick/9781405964548

Rural Hours|2024|10|0|1945|8,4,4,4,7,8,1,7,9,9|Harriet Baker|Archival literary biography compares how three writers changed their work and routines after moving to rural England. The shared comparison offers a limited transferable account of place and creative practice. Detailed domestic scenes are useful biography but remote from the requested mechanisms. Endpoint 1945 approximates the central early twentieth-century setting. https://wp.penguin.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/CatalogueSS24_Online_LowRes_Revised.pdf

Madrid: A New Biography|2024|10|0||8,7,5,6,7,9,4,8,8,8|Luke Stegemann|Explains the growth of a capital through imperial government, culture, migration and economic change. Connections beyond city chronology supply some transferable value; urban history remains the dominant topic. Broad coverage to the present gives no single historical endpoint. https://yalebooks.yale.edu/book/9780300286267/madrid/

A Voyage Around the Queen|2024|10|10|2022|7,4,4,4,6,7,2,8,9,8|Craig Brown|Biographical collage examines monarchy through the reactions, rituals and projections of other people. Social signaling and institutional symbolism provide limited transfer; anecdotes dominate over causal analysis. Royal celebrity and political power incur both thematic deductions. The inspected description does not establish a serious V3 failure. https://www.harpercollinsrights.co.uk/products/a-voyage-around-the-queen-craig-brown-9780008557522/

The Message|2024|10|10||6,5,5,5,7,7,3,7,8,8|Ta-Nehisi Coates|Three reported essays examine how national stories frame public perception in Senegal, South Carolina and Israel-Palestine. Comparison supplies a transferable question about narrative selection; brief visits and a strong authorial frame constrain causal confidence. Race, media and politics dominate. Advocacy alone is not V2 or V6, and the inspected evidence does not establish campaign recruitment or extremist advocacy. https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/653438/the-message-by-ta-nehisi-coates/
